request.prompt: Landing page for Kite Bookkeeping's fixed-price monthly bookkeeping plans. It MUST include: a pricing section with our three plans (Starter, Growth, Concierge), an FAQ section, and a comparison section contrasting us with hiring an in-house bookkeeper. CTA: pick a plan.

config.companyDescription: Kite Bookkeeping pairs small businesses with a dedicated bookkeeper on flat monthly plans.
